characters.role_zh: 主角，回到故乡接手旧港口的年轻建筑师
characters.role_en: Protagonist, a young architect returning home to restore the old harbor
characters.bio_zh: 林岚在大城市做了五年设计，却在外婆去世后收到一封信：海风港的老码头要被拆除。她决定留下来，用合成与修缮让港口重新热闹。
characters.bio_en: After five years designing in the big city, Lan receives a letter after her grandmother passes: Breezeport's old pier is to be demolished. She stays to rebuild it, one merge and one repair at a time.

characters.bio_zh: 阿博在港口打了四十年鱼，嘴硬心软。他记得港口每一块木板的故事，却从不肯说自己为什么不再出远海。
characters.bio_en: Bo has fished here for forty years—gruff outside, soft inside. He knows the story behind every plank, but never says why he stopped sailing far out.

characters.role_en: Teahouse owner who hears every rumor
characters.bio_zh: 小梅开着港口唯一的茶馆，什么八卦都瞒不过她。她热心又爱操心，常常替人牵线搭桥。
characters.bio_en: Mei runs the harbor's only teahouse; no rumor escapes her. Warm and meddling, she loves playing matchmaker.

characters.role_zh: 开发商的代表，表面冷淡
characters.role_en: Developer's representative, cool on the surface
characters.bio_zh: 程骏奉命来评估港口的拆迁价值，西装笔挺、话不多。可他总在深夜一个人去灯塔下坐着。
characters.bio_en: Jun was sent to assess the harbor for demolition—sharp suit, few words. Yet he sits alone under the lighthouse late at night.

characters.role_zh: 面包店学徒，梦想开自己的店
characters.role_en: Bakery apprentice who dreams of her own shop
characters.bio_zh: 十九岁的娜娜每天四点起床揉面，乐观得像刚出炉的面包。她最大的愿望是在修好的码头开一家花与面包的小店。
characters.bio_en: Nineteen-year-old Nana kneads dough at 4 a.m., cheerful as fresh bread. Her dream: a little flower-and-bread shop on the rebuilt pier.
